title: My Soul Thirsts for You

questions.question: Hear my prayer, O Lord; give ear to my pleas for what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 143:1 (ESV): "give ear to my pleas for mercy!"

questions.question: In your faithfulness answer me, in your what?
Enter not into judgment with your servant, for no one living is righteous before whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 143:2 (ESV): "for no one living is righteous before you."

questions.question: For the enemy has pursued my soul; he has crushed my life to the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 143:3 (ESV): "he has crushed my life to the ground;"

questions.question: He has made me sit in darkness like those long what?
Therefore my spirit faints within me; my heart within me is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 143:4 (ESV): "my heart within me is appalled."

questions.question: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all that you have done; I ponder the work of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 143:5 (ESV): "I ponder the work of your hands."

questions.question: I stretch out my hands to you; my soul thirsts for you like a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 143:6 (ESV): "my soul thirsts for you like a parched land."

questions.question: Answer me quickly, O Lord! My spirit does what?
Let me hear in the morning of your steadfast love, for in you I do what?
Teach me the way I should go, for to you I lift up my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 143:8 (ESV): "for to you I lift up my soul."

questions.question: Deliver me from my enemies, O Lord! I have fled to you for what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 143:9 (ESV): "I have fled to you for refuge."

questions.question: Teach me to do your will, for you are my what?
Let your good Spirit lead me on level what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 143:10 (ESV): "Let your good Spirit lead me on level ground!"

questions.question: Who is the author of Psalm 143?

key_verse_text: Let me hear in the morning of your steadfast love, for in you I trust. Make me know the way I should go, for to you I lift up my soul.
